usage: agentbreeder evals show [-h] [--project DIR] [--output DIR]
                               [--agent NAME] [--state-dir STATE_DIR]
                               [--stack DIR] [--json] [--content]
                               [RUN]

positional arguments:
  RUN                   Run id (default: the newest)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project DIR         The agent project: reports are read from DIR/deploy
                        (default: .)
  --output DIR          Read reports from DIR (as release --output)
  --agent NAME          Only this agent's reports
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --json
  --content             Also show each reply and the full judge explanation
                        (redacted, capped)
